title: Current place of Health Facility registration in 105 CMR 700.004(A)
rule_summary: In the current 105 CMR 700.004(A), paragraph (2) lists the practitioners required to be registered under 105 CMR 700.004(A)(1), with (2)(d) Nurse Midwife and (2)(f) Pharmacist, and paragraph (3) lists the facilities that shall register for the purpose of purchase and storage of controlled substances in Massachusetts, with (3)(d) Health Facility. M.G.L. c. 112, s. 24B1/2(d) states its Health Facility cross-reference as 105 CMR 700.004(A)(2)(d); in the current regulation Health Facility registration appears at 105 CMR 700.004(A)(3)(d).
exam_relevance: Tests that the statutory exemption of a retail drug business practising collaborative drug therapy management from Health Facility registration refers to the facility registration now found at 105 CMR 700.004(A)(3)(d), not to the practitioner item now numbered (A)(2)(d).

authority.name: Massachusetts Department of Public Health regulations

common_confusions: Looking up 105 CMR 700.004(A)(2)(d) in the current regulation and finding Nurse Midwife rather than Health Facility; the statute's cross-reference does not match the current numbering.
verification_notes: Read in the current mass.gov PDF of 105 CMR 700.000 and in the current text of M.G.L. c. 112, s. 24B1/2 on malegislature.gov on 2026-09-17.
